postprocessing.selection_basis: All geometry limits are held constant from v21. The v21 errors are addressed through preregistered data replay rather than post-audit geometry editing.

sampling.selection_basis: Preregistered in configs/supervised_labeler_v22_gt_review.yaml before any v22 pool pixels or training were opened. Exact v21 miss images receive positive replay weight 40, general small-helmet examples receive weight 4, and v21 false-positive images receive hard-negative replay weight 28.
